text: Its possible to feel suffocated in a room even when its a comfortable temperature. This is because temperature is only one part of comfort. Humidity is the problem. When its high, it slows down evaporation of moisture from your skin. That makes the air feel heavy. Its also about airflow. If air is not moving, carbon dioxide and odors and heat just hang around. That makes the room feel stuffy. Air conditioning can cool the air but it does not mean it will reduce humidity or move the air. Opening a window or running a fan or ventilation can help. It moves the air and lowers the moisture.
